title.zh: 一次讓我學到教訓的錯誤

subtitle: 全民英檢中級：寫一次犯錯的經驗與學到的事
task: Everyone makes mistakes, and some of them teach us important lessons. Write an essay of 120–160 words about a mistake you once made. In your essay, (1) describe what happened, (2) explain how you felt and what you did afterward, and (3) tell what you learned from it.
taskZh: 每個人都會犯錯，有些錯誤會讓我們學到重要的事。請寫一篇 120–160 字的英文短文，描述你曾犯過的一個錯：(1) 說明發生了什麼事，(2) 說明你當時的感受與後來怎麼做，(3) 說明你從中學到什麼。
focus: 內容：經過、感受與做法、學到的事三個要求都要寫到
組織：依時間順序敘述，段落之間用轉折詞連接
文法：過去式與過去完成式正確，句型有變化
用字與拼字：用字恰當具體，拼字與標點正確

en: Last spring, I made a mistake that I still remember clearly. My best friend Kevin had lent me his notes before our final exam, and I promised to return them in two days. However, I left the notebook on the bus and never found it again.

At first, I was too embarrassed to tell him the truth. I kept making excuses for almost a week, and Kevin began to look worried. Finally, I told him what had happened and said sorry. Then I borrowed notes from other classmates and copied them into a new notebook for him.

From this experience, I learned that hiding a problem only makes it worse. Kevin was upset about the notebook, but he was more upset that I had not been honest. Now, whenever I do something wrong, I admit it right away and try my best to fix it.
zh: 去年春天，我犯了一個到現在還記得很清楚的錯。我最好的朋友凱文在期末考前借我他的筆記，我答應兩天後還他。然而，我把筆記本忘在公車上，再也沒找回來。
一開始，我太難為情了，不敢告訴他實話。我找了將近一個星期的藉口，凱文開始顯得很擔心。最後，我告訴他發生了什麼事，並向他道歉。接著，我向其他同學借筆記，幫他抄進一本新的筆記本。
從這次經驗中，我學到隱瞞問題只會讓事情更糟。凱文對筆記本的事很難過，但讓他更難過的是我沒有誠實。現在，每當我做錯事，我都會立刻承認，並盡力彌補。

patterns.pattern: I made a mistake that I still remember …
patterns.zh: 開頭點出主題，用關係子句補充
patterns.example: Last spring, I made a mistake that I still remember clearly.
At first, I was too embarrassed to tell him the truth.

patterns.pattern: From this experience, I learned that …
patterns.zh: 說明從經驗中學到的事
patterns.example: From this experience, I learned that hiding a problem only makes it worse.

patterns.zh: 每當……，我就……（說明現在的習慣）
patterns.example: Now, whenever I do something wrong, I admit it right away and try my best to fix it.

parts: I left the notebook on the bus.
combine.answer: I left the notebook on the bus and never found it again.

parts: I could not tell him the truth.
combine.answer: I was too embarrassed to tell him the truth.

paraphrase.sentence: Hiding a problem only makes it worse.
answers: If you hide a problem, it only gets worse.
Keeping a problem secret only makes things worse.
